intro.title: Hunter English
intro.subtitle: English for travel: from zero (A0) to fluent (C1).
intro.whatText: A 1-hour-a-day trainer: a short rule → lots of RU→EN phrase building → listening (dictation) → speaking (shadowing) → spaced repetition. The goal is travel: understand people by ear and answer.
intro.loreText: You are a Hunter, and this is the System. Ranks E → D → C → B → A → S (matching CEFR levels) are your path. XP and streaks build discipline, but only Gates — the System’s exams — raise your rank. First, the System will assess your level and offer a starting point.
intro.dayText: Every day brings quests: reviews, a lesson, dictation. Progress lives in this browser — hit “Save progress” on the dashboard from time to time. Honest milestones: travel conversation (A2) in about 4–6 months, a confident B1 tourist in 12–15 months at 1 h/day plus 20 minutes of listening.
